package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

// scenario for slow_work_inside_transaction_scope: Loop-heavy or slow work performed while a transaction appears open.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: warning.
func scenario397Positive(db *sql.DB) error {
	tx, err := db.Begin()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()

	rows, err := tx.Query("SELECT id, data FROM items")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var payloads []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var data string
		rows.Scan(nil, &data)
		payloads = append(payloads, data)
	}

	sort.Strings(payloads)
	for i := range payloads {
		payloads[i] = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(payloads[i]))
	}

	_, err = tx.Exec("UPDATE items SET processed = true")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit()
}
